name: Thomas More University of Applied Sciences
noDeadline: Apply up to the start of the semester
summary: University of applied sciences in the Antwerp province; nine English-taught professional bachelor's in Mechelen, Geel and Sint-Katelijne-Waver.

ib.text: A diploma giving access to comparable higher education at home; the IB Diploma exempts you from an English test. No application fee, no numerus clausus; you can apply before you graduate.

dates.label: Applications open for a September 2027 start (visa timetable)
Application deadline for non-EEA students needing a visa, September 2027 start

programmes.name: Applied Computer Science
programmes.about: Programming, networks, security, IoT and AI in a first year at the Geel campus, then a specialisation track and a semester-long internship with a portfolio as the capstone.
programmes.ib: Tracks: Application Development, Artificial Intelligence or Digital Innovation. Also starts in February (that start may take longer than three years).
programmes.selectionNote: No selection or cap: a diploma that gives access to higher education at home admits you, and the IB Diploma covers the English requirement.

programmes.name: Automotive Technology
programmes.about: Drivetrains, vehicle electronics and diagnostics, then electric, hybrid and autonomous vehicles, taught in a workshop of more than 20 cars; you specialise in motorsport, motorcycles or trucks and finish with a 12-week thesis internship.
programmes.selectionNote: No selection or cap: a diploma that gives access to higher education at home admits you, and the IB Diploma covers the English requirement.

programmes.name: Electronics-ICT
programmes.about: Electronics and ICT on the Sint-Katelijne-Waver campus, where you specialise in applied AI, embedded hardware, embedded software, infrastructure and cybersecurity, or software architecture.
programmes.ib: Tracks: Applied AI, Embedded Hardware, Embedded Software, Infrastructure & Cyber Security, Software Architecture & Development.
programmes.selectionNote: No selection or cap: a diploma that gives access to higher education at home admits you, and the IB Diploma covers the English requirement.

programmes.name: Information Management and Multimedia: International Digital Experience Design
programmes.about: UX, interaction and motion design plus front- and back-end web development; every semester you design and build a real digital product or immersive experience and present it to a professional jury. No tech background needed.
programmes.selectionNote: No selection or cap: an access diploma admits you, and the IB covers English. September start only; this degree does not start in February.

programmes.name: International Business Management
programmes.about: International trade, marketing, finance and supply chains with a language of your choice; "3 countries in 3 years" through an international project, an exchange and a 12-week internship abroad.
programmes.ib: Majors: International Business and Trade, Global Supply Chain Management, or International Applied Data Intelligence. Also starts in February.
programmes.selectionNote: No selection or cap: a diploma that gives access to higher education at home admits you, and the IB Diploma covers the English requirement.

programmes.name: International Communication and Media
programmes.about: Brand communication, marketing, consumer psychology and media production, with a semester abroad or a minor in year 2 and a 15-week international internship in your final year.
programmes.ib: Tracks: Branding and Activation, Content Strategy & Engagement, or Public and Corporate Affairs. Also starts in February.
programmes.selectionNote: No selection or cap: a diploma that gives access to higher education at home admits you, and the IB Diploma covers the English requirement.

programmes.name: International Journalism
programmes.about: Reporting in an English-speaking newsroom from year one, with tracks such as crisis reporting and the international newsroom, an 80-day internship in Belgium or abroad and a magazine, podcast or documentary as your final work.
programmes.selectionNote: No selection or cap: a diploma that gives access to higher education at home admits you, and the IB Diploma covers the English requirement.

programmes.name: International Media and Entertainment Business
programmes.about: The business of TV, film, festivals and publishing: storytelling, media technology and transmedia production, then entrepreneurship in a start-up studio and a 16-week final internship, with study trips abroad.
programmes.selectionNote: No selection or cap: a diploma that gives access to higher education at home admits you, and the IB Diploma covers the English requirement.

programmes.name: International Tourism and Leisure
programmes.about: Tourism, management and languages taught through industry labs in immersive experiences, tour operating and corporate travel, with an exchange in year 2 and a 15-week international internship in year 3.
programmes.selectionNote: No selection or cap: a diploma that gives access to higher education at home admits you, and the IB Diploma covers the English requirement.

notes: Thomas More sets no application deadline for EEA students on its bachelor's: you can apply up to the start of the semester.
Several of the business, media and tourism degrees also start in February.
